identity.name: Inventory Particles Matcha Compatibility
legacy_names: Inventory Particles Matcha Compatibility Resource Pack

goals: Make Inventory Particles correctly render the six selected Matcha component-backed and Ribbits stack identities without changing Inventory Particles, Matcha Flavoured, or Ribbits.
Provide exclusive stack-aware spawner dispatch for only those exact target stacks while leaving all non-target Inventory Particles behavior untouched.
scope: C4 is a narrow client-side Fabric compatibility mod. It marks its six data-defined Inventory Particles spawners during config linking and, immediately before a spawner runs, suppresses every nonmatching spawner only for an exact target stack.

The exact targets are minecraft:poisonous_potato with minecraft:item_model minecraft:green_curry, minecraft:ramen, or minecraft:heart_container; ribbits:glowcap; ribbits:toadstool_heart; and minecraft:filled_map with both minecraft:map_id and minecraft:custom_data.ribbits:ribbit_village_explorer_map=true.
C4 retains five standalone replacement particle definitions and no longer overlays Inventory Particles dirt_sand, potion, fallback-family, or other upstream JSON resources.

exclusions: Modifying, redistributing, or forking Inventory Particles, Matcha Flavoured, Ribbits, their artwork, their registries, their renderers, or their resource definitions.
Any resource-pack overlay, global Inventory Particles disablement, generic poisonous-potato/filled-map/Ribbits-item matching, unrelated automatic-family behavior, or creative-tab change.

Runtime deployment, Test Instance Manager mutation, Test Slot assignment, dedicated-Workbench mutation, or access to the protected Matcha Flavoured 26.1.2 gameplay instance during this static C4 implementation.

state.milestone: C1 was a resource-pack prototype with user-reported functional RUNTIME_FAIL. C2 was a resource-pack prototype with RESOURCE_RELOAD_FAIL after invalid this_type:number predicates. C3 passed reload (450/450 particle configs, 20/20 families, VANILLA and MODDED linking) but user-reported functional RUNTIME_FAIL: Green Curry still leaked poisonous-potato/default behavior, Glowcap had no intended replacement, and the Ribbit Village Explorer Map remained gray/sand-like; no unreported target is claimed to have passed. C4 is the first Fabric implementation, ACTIVE / STATIC_PASS / NOT_DEPLOYED / RUNTIME_UNTESTED, and occupies no test slot.
